VDB fixtures generated by the original OpenVDB 13.0.0 Wasm build.
Both archives contain a float level-set sphere and a float fog-density sphere.
Compression: ZIP and Blosc, both with active-value masks.
reference.json records original desktop Blender volume modifier evaluations.
Regenerate with native_build.py --check-deps, then verify_volume_desktop.py.
